questions.answer:
Forest landscape restoration

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: animal biodiversity and global change were probably the most interesting for me. The first one is very research focused, helps you learn how to develop a research project on your own, going through every step, very practical. The second is a very fascinating topic that has a lot of potential in the modern era and in the context of climate change.
